system.description: The enchanter makes a creature stumble and lose its balance. The victim of the spell must immediately make a Skill roll for Agility. Failure means the victim tumbles to the ground. Success means the victim takes no notice of what has happened and is able to continue as normal.
system.summary: Unbalances a creature so that it falls to the ground.
